digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill documentation and defect tracking
propositions: Skill closes bug tickets without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, making defect escape rate unmeasurable.
Auto-blame fallback charges defects to whoever wrote most of the file and cannot detect producer-consumer mismatches where fix site differs from cause site.
rebar-debug must identify originating ticket via exact line blame and commit trailers before RCA writeback and include --caused-by on close.
Unmet-obligation case (producer change not propagated to consumers) requires date test to detect old correct lines and producer-side history search for recovery.
Worktree bootstrap uses bare git worktree add without provisioning virtualenv, causing pre-commit hooks to fail on missing ruff/mypy.
Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap via make worktree and run commands with worktree venv first on PATH.
